verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no programmatic API for managing plugins, and nothing claims parity between the UI and an API. Some actions have CLI equivalents (e.g. `codex plugin marketplace add`), and the public marketplace JSON is a read-only catalog. Submission, review and publication tracking are described only through the portal and Plugins page, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec (all candidate paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
